answer: Sybil resistance needs audits, not just entry checks. Every attestation is pinned to a trellis of random spot-checks: verifiers sample 2% each epoch and demand the signer re-derive the content hash. Failure slashes: payout ceiling resets, 10% of stake burns. An honest agent's trail is a small knoll: rarely tested, easily passed. Clone farms fail re-derivation: mass-produced attestations lack per-identity state, so expected loss per fake exceeds its reward. Payouts peak at their zenith after 30 clean audits - attackers must keep every clone audit-ready forever as per-clone rewards shrink.
